Subject: WIDOW from Silent Hill: Townfall, solely the named model creature_widow_03 in the reference. The source image is the complete model on black, not an outfit mood board. Retain the lean adult-sized nonhuman body, very long slender arms, two long bare legs and natural slightly bent uneven leg posture. Keep the pale face-covering hood-like draped surface with a long smooth rounded crown and long wavy folds falling over the entire faceless head, neck and upper chest. The head remains completely covered, with no readable eye, mouth, human hair or new facial features. Follow the source pale gray-beige mottled material without adding injuries or fresh gore.

Retain exactly the worn muted gray ragged garment around waist/hips and thighs, its diagonal wraps, faded paper/newsprint-like cloth strips and a small number of hanging rectangular faded photo/paper pieces as in the source. Preserve the source's restrained frayed bands trailing backward, not a dramatic new cape. Both hands remain attached in their original drooping arrangement, including the hand holding one SHORT FLAT BROKEN WOOD STRIP low beside the thigh. It is a modest brown piece of wood, not a metal knife, sword, spear, long club or firearm. Match this wood piece's small size from the source; no added weapon or new accessory. Upper arms, hand/finger shapes and bare feet should follow the source. Do not add shoes, armored bracers, black funeral veil, black flowing dress, headdress, spikes, exposed internal organs or new wound details. Copy the final model's distinct silhouette and source materials while turning the camera to an exact right lateral profile. All hanging strips, wood tip, crown, fingertips, heels and toes must fit well within the transparent canvas. No action effect, attack windup or new combat behavior.
